summary.notes: All cross-file threading rules satisfied. All conventions compliant. 3 informational warnings documented below.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
cross_file_threading.details: 52 tasks in sop_modules.json. 52 matching task_production_rates in production.json. All TSK_SCRP_* (47) and TSK_RRP_EXT_* (5) matched. Zero orphan tasks.

task_count_by_module.note: Module task slots sum to 57 but unique task count is 52 — all tasks counted once.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
cross_file_threading.details: 6 material systems checked. SYS_EXT_SCRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND [QT2-QT4], SYS_EXT_SCRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP [QT2-QT4], SYS_EXT_STCO_PRIMER_ALKALI [QT2-QT4], SYS_EXT_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_STD [QT2-QT3], SYS_EXT_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_PREM [QT4], SYS_EXT_STCO_FINISH_ELASTOMERIC [QT3-QT4]. All within spec QT2-QT4 range.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
cross_file_threading.details: 16 PaintScope inputs declared. All 16 consumed: IN_SF_STUCCO_WALL (primary surface), IN_EA_ELEVATIONS (fixed tasks), IN_ENUM_ACCESS_TYPE (modifier), IN_ENUM_SUBSTRATE_STATE_EXT (primer routing), IN_ENUM_SUBSTRATE_TYPE_STUCCO (task gating + modifier), IN_ENUM_TEXTURE_PROFILE_STUCCO (modifier), IN_ENUM_COATING_SYSTEM_STUCCO (task gating), IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 (RRP module), IN_BOOL_EIFS_INSURANCE_VERIFIED (admin gate), IN_LF_CAULK_JOINTS (caulk tasks), 5 protection inputs (setup tasks), IN_SF_EXT_PROTECT_VEHICLE_DRIVEWAY (RP-specific).

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
cross_file_threading.details: All PS_ keys in production.json task_production_rates reference declared PaintScope keys from spec.json required_paintscope_inputs.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
cross_file_threading.details: 8 zones declared in spec.json. All 8 have matching protection_metadata in sop_modules.json: ext_landscape_perimeter, ext_hardscape_walk, ext_hardscape_patio, ext_light_fixture, ext_hvac_unit, ext_vehicle_driveway (RP-specific), ext_ground_cover (RP-specific), ext_rrp_containment.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
cross_file_threading.details: Phase sequence verified: MOD_SCRP_SETUP (setup) -> MOD_SCRP_ASSESS (prep) -> MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT (prep) -> MOD_SCRP_PREP (prep) -> MOD_SCRP_PRIME (prime) -> MOD_SCRP_FINISH_1 (finish) -> MOD_SCRP_INTERSTAGE (interstage) -> MOD_SCRP_FINISH_2 (finish) -> MOD_SCRP_FINAL_INSPECT (cleanup) -> MOD_SCRP_CLEANUP (cleanup). Correct.

cross_file_threading.rule: RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
cross_file_threading.details: All 52 tasks have matching UOM across files. SF=28 tasks, FIXED=12 tasks, LF=5 tasks, EA=2 tasks. No UOM mismatches.

convention_compliance.details: All 23 consumables in materials.json use CON_ prefix. Zero CONS_ occurrences.
All severity references use canonical values.
All modules use canonical phase values. No 'protect' or 'protection' phase labels.

convention_compliance.check: All units uppercase (EA, SF, LF, FIXED)
convention_compliance.details: All unit_of_measure values are uppercase. Zero lowercase occurrences.
All consumable categories in materials.json use canonical values.

convention_compliance.check: Sheen: single values only (never compound like eggshell/satin)
convention_compliance.details: Sheen dimension has only 'flat' and 'satin'. No compound values.
All spec-owned tasks use TSK_SCRP_*, modules use MOD_SCRP_*, factors use FAC_SCRP_*. Shared RRP module uses TSK_RRP_EXT_* and MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT. No prefix collisions.

hard_constraint_enforcement.details: All elastomeric finish tasks (TSK_SCRP_FINISH_ELASTO_*) have applies_when substrate_type: ['traditional_stucco']. No path to activate elastomeric on EIFS. Compatibility rule COMPAT-SCRP-001 enforced in spec.json.
TSK_SCRP_CRACK_ASSESS is first task in MOD_SCRP_PREP. Description explicitly states HARD STOP. Hard stop documented in compatibility rules.
TSK_SCRP_EIFS_WASH description specifies '<500 PSI'. Separate task from TSK_SCRP_PRESSURE_WASH_TRAD (1500-3000 PSI). Each gated by substrate_type.
application_method dimension values are ['spray_backroll', 'roll', 'brush']. 'spray' is not a valid value. Configuration dimension has prohibited: ['spray'].
All elastomeric finish tasks have appears_in_tiers: ['QT3', 'QT4']. QT2 excluded. Material system SYS_EXT_STCO_FINISH_ELASTOMERIC limited to QT3-QT4.
TSK_SCRP_EIFS_INSURANCE_VERIFY present with applies_when substrate_type: ['EIFS']. Administrative gate task.
MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT has applies_when pre_1978: true. All 5 RRP tasks gated by pre_1978.

hard_constraint_enforcement.constraint: Stacking partition: prep pool vs coating pool never cross
hard_constraint_enforcement.details: production.json MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING defines separate pools. FAC_SCRP_CONDITION and FAC_SCRP_RRP apply to prep tasks ONLY. FAC_QT applies to coating tasks ONLY. FAC_EXT_ACCESS and FAC_SCRP_TEXTURE_PROFILE are shared. Verified no cross-pool contamination in applies_to lists.

rate_reasonability.check: Finish coat rates match NC sibling
rate_reasonability.details: Acrylic spray_backroll: 137 SF/hr (NC=137). Acrylic roll: 112 SF/hr (NC=112). Elastomeric spray_backroll: 90 SF/hr (NC=90). Elastomeric roll: 75 SF/hr (NC=75). Brush detail: 45/65 SF/hr (NC=45/65). All direct transfers — correct per doctrine (same products, same method).

rate_reasonability.check: RP prep rates calibrated from NC with documented adjustments
rate_reasonability.details: Pressure wash: 450 SF/hr (NC 500, -10% for existing coating debris). Light scrape: 100 SF/hr (RP_NEW, calibrated). Heavy scrape: 50 SF/hr (RP_NEW, 2x slower than light). Degloss: 200 SF/hr (RP_NEW). Chalk remediation: 175 SF/hr (RP_NEW). All rates documented with basis notes.

rate_reasonability.check: RP primer rates differentiated from NC
rate_reasonability.details: Chalk-binding spray_backroll: 325 SF/hr (NC alkali 350, slightly slower due to heavier body). Stain-block spray_backroll: 350 SF/hr (same as NC alkali). Alkali spot: 80 SF/hr (slower — brush spot work). All documented.

Worst case coating: 3.84x (dash 2.0 x scaffold 1.60 x QT4 1.20). Under 4.0x cap. Worst case prep CAN exceed cap in extreme combinations (condition x RRP x access x texture) — documented and flagged for estimator review.

warnings.description: Prep pool modifier stacking can exceed 4.0x in extreme combinations (POOR + RRP + scaffold + dash = 12.80x theoretical). This is documented in production.json MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING and flagged for estimator review. No action required — extreme combinations are rare and documented.
warnings.recommendation: Ensure estimation engine includes sanity check on prep pool combined modifier > 4.0x with estimator review flag.

warnings.description: TSK_SCRP_PROTECT_GROUND_SCRAPING uses IN_SF_STUCCO_WALL as rate basis (ground cover proportional to wall area). This is an approximation — actual ground cover area depends on building footprint perimeter, not wall area. Acceptable for v1 estimation.
warnings.recommendation: Future enhancement: consider adding PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.GROUND_COVER as a separate PaintScope key for explicit ground cover area input.

warnings.description: Condition scale to substrate state mapping is documented but not enforced as a formal compatibility rule. GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING/localized FAILING, POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING/widespread FAILING. The mapping is advisory — field assessor assigns both independently.
warnings.recommendation: Consider adding a compatibility rule to guide (not enforce) the condition-to-state mapping in future versions.
